summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo, without running tests or repository code and without committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text with click spans appended last; Opacity blends only the color and keeps other style attributes including click metadata; the layout resolver needed no change because its Edge protocol already has min_size. Tests added: bar tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, an opacity metadata test appended to tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (+ __init__.py). Also added docs/reference/tabs.md and sandbox/tabs.py with sandbox/tabs.css. Choices: the bar position is a full-list index, resolved to displayed tabs by name so duplicate names highlight the correct tab; can_focus is inherited from Widget's __init_subclass__; inactive labels are dimmed via Opacity appended as spans. Unverified: no tests were run, and the code relies on rich 11.2.0 behavior (Text.apply_meta, Style.from_meta, and meta preservation under Style addition) that I did not check against the installed library.
